intro_say: Trump's day, in five quotes. Let's go!
outro_say: Love it or hate it, every speech and post from today is linked in the caption. Follow for tomorrow's five!

quotes.quote: I had 10 minutes, so I came as Donald Trump.
quotes.quote_say: I had ten minutes, so I came as Donald Trump.
quotes.intro_say: On his costume, arriving at the Mar-a-Lago Halloween party.

quotes.quote: I thought it was totally obnoxious and outrageous, and it's not acceptable. Not acceptable at all.
quotes.intro_say: On a reported legal payment to his former lawyer Alina Habba.

quotes.quote: The arch is going to be more beautiful than the Arc de Triomphe.
quotes.intro_say: On his planned arch in Washington.
quotes.said_before_note: Has compared it to the Paris arch since October 2025

quotes.quote: Angie Nixon's a low IQ person and she shouldn't be running.
quotes.intro_say: On Angie Nixon, the Democratic Senate candidate in Florida.

quotes.quote: We've made $25 trillion in wealth over the last, since I'm president, for the last 19 months, I guess, 25 trillion.
quotes.quote_say: We've made twenty-five trillion dollars in wealth over the last, since I'm president, for the last nineteen months, I guess, twenty-five trillion.
